item.title: LinkedIn Headshot From Park Photo

turns.text: Can you turn this into a square LinkedIn headshot? A navy blazer and a plain light grey background, please.

item.tests: Creates a polished LinkedIn headshot from the supplied photo while preserving the subject's identity.

answer_sheet.Clothing and background: Navy blazer and plain light grey background.
answer_sheet.Lighting and expression: Natural, approachable and professional; keep my smile.

must_haves: The woman is recognisably the same person as in portrait-woman.jpg, with her curly dark hair retained.
The park is replaced with a plain light grey background.
The square image has a centred head-and-shoulders composition with the full top of her hair visible.
Lighting and skin texture look natural, without obvious facial or clothing artifacts.
